worked_example.note: demo example is the TX variant (reproduces 0.788~0.8); noaa variant gives 0.215 for same inputs (different ref scaling) — initial FAIL was a test mislabel, implementation CORRECT

pct_over_1_note: 0% is the intentional final clip to [0,1] in hwp_from_components, not a normalizer bug
event_battery_note: event percentiles use gridMET DAILY-MEAN wind proxy (G=1.5*vs) — known to damp windstorm days (HANDBOOK: 'treat historical HWP as approximate'); hence winter wind events Smokehouse/Windy Deuce rank 70-75th pctile via this proxy while spring/summer events rank 87-92nd. Live serving should use HRRR gusts, where windstorm days rank far higher.
